en.askTitle: Swap in your own details and get the same Tokyo start plan, with official deadlines kept apart from estimates
en.runTitle: Taipei to Tokyo on a Working Holiday: arriving around 1 June 2027 with TWD 250,000

fields.label: Age, Taiwan residency and passport details
Application status
fields.value: Wants a Japan Working Holiday visa

fields.label: Japanese level
fields.placeholder: e.g. can order food and ask for directions

fields.label: Housing needs
fields.value: Share house or monthly apartment, costs compared

en.template: Plan my Tokyo start from Taiwan using {profile}, {past}, {status}, {arrival}, {savings}, {japanese} and {housing}. Separate official deadlines from estimates, compare full housing bills and list what to confirm before paying. Help structure my own holiday plan; do not apply, contact, reserve or pay.

phases.title: Read the exchange association's rules and the official steps after arrival
phases.note: Application rules and timing, newcomer registration, insurance and pension
phases.judgment: It did not guess the 2027 dates. They were not yet published, so it said so plainly and told the reader to keep 1 June flexible. Five of the eight housing rooms it checked were showing as full, so it noted that none confirms June 2027 availability.

phases.title: Collect eight dated housing listings and pay examples
phases.note: Share houses vs monthly apartments, plus Tokyo wage figures
phases.judgment: It kept wage examples labelled as examples. Tokyo’s legal minimum is ¥1,280 an hour from 1 October 2026, while the job ads it found (¥1,300+ at McDonald’s, ¥1,700+ at UNIQLO Ginza) are neither averages nor guaranteed offers.

phases.title: Write the guide and source list, then have it independently checked
phases.judgment: The independent colleague re-added the budget and caught one slip: the source list said ¥504,000 would be left, but the sum (1,175,000 − 675,000) is ¥500,000. It was fixed before delivery.

workers: Inspected eight official Tokyo room listings (four share-house rooms, four furnished monthly apartments) and worked out what two months would really cost in each
Checked the official first-two-weeks steps in Tokyo (address registration, health insurance, pension, bank account, phone) and looked for real part-time pay examples
Read the finished guide on its own and rechecked the facts and every sum against what was asked

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的情况，同样拿到一份东京起步方案，官方期限和估算分得清清楚楚
zh.runTitle: 台北到东京的打工度假：2027 年 6 月 1 日前后抵达，存款 25 万新台币

fields.label: 年龄、台湾居住及护照情况
以往打工度假获批记录
目前申请状态
fields.value: 想申请日本打工度假签证

fields.label: 可调整的到达日期
fields.value: 2027 年 6 月 1 日前后抵达东京

fields.label: 住房需求
fields.value: 合租屋或按月租的公寓，比较费用

zh.template: 请按{profile}、{past}、{status}、{arrival}、{savings}、{japanese}和{housing}，规划我的东京起步。分清官方期限和估算，比较完整住房账单，列出付款前要确认什么。协助组织我自己的度假计划，不申请、不联系、不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 阅读交流协会的申请规则和抵达后的官方手续
phases.note: 申请规则与时间、新住民登记、保险和年金
phases.judgment: 它没有去猜 2027 年的日期。这些日期尚未公布，它就直接写明，并提醒读者 6 月 1 日要留有弹性。它查看的 8 个房源中有 5 个显示已满，所以也注明没有一个能确认 2027 年 6 月仍有空房。

phases.title: 收集 8 个带日期的房源和时薪例子
phases.note: 合租屋与按月公寓，以及东京的工资数字
phases.judgment: 它把工资例子明确标成“例子”。东京法定最低时薪自 2026 年 10 月 1 日起是 1,280 日元，而它找到的招聘信息（麦当劳 1,300 日元起、UNIQLO 银座 1,700 日元起）既不是平均值，也不保证录用。

phases.title: 写成指南和来源清单，再请人独立复核
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事把预算重新加了一遍，抓出一处笔误：来源清单写着剩下 504,000 日元，而算式（1,175,000 − 675,000）的结果是 500,000 日元。交付前已改正。

workers: 逐一查看东京 8 个官方房源（4 间合租屋单人房、4 间带家具的按月公寓），算出各自住两个月的真实花费
核对到东京后前两周的官方手续（住址登记、健康保险、年金、银行账户、手机），并查找真实的兼职时薪例子
单独通读成稿，对照需求重新核对事实和每一笔加减
